name: Panther Mastery
objectiveText: Sir S. J. Erlgadin of Nesingwary's Expedition wants you to kill 10 Panthers .   Panther slain  ( 10 )

replies:
29-30, 15-16
NW of there you get the raptors to

comments.body: Check East and South of the ruins of Zul'Kunda. Start look around 28,10.
A really good spot with quick respawns is [b]29,16 28,15[/b] area. The Stranglethorn raptors are right next to them with a quick respawn too.

Here let me make it easy since everyone here makes it too complicated.

Panthers are directly West from the expedition site where quest is given.  East from Zulkunda ruins.  North of Ballal Ruins.  Directly there in the center of all the coordinates.
dont go to 36, 36. Those are stealth panthers and are for the next part of the panther mastery series.

28 11 is the best                              

GL/HF
These hang out west of the hunter camp, over near the Bloodscalp troll ruins. They were most common up on a small plateau. Once you find one, you will find more in the area easily enough.
northwest of the expedition, but there are other things inthe area so be careful, such as tigers and trolls.
IT'S 30,11-28,11 panthers and some tigers 33lvl

the stranglehorn raptors are at 29,15.  Panthers are right next to them.
Around 28.9 !
the coords are NW of the closest troll place u will find about 100 there there are also lvl 32-35 Elder straglethron tigers there.

For gods sake. From Nesingwary's Expedition Site, if you are facing the site, and the water is behind you, turn RIGHT. Keep walking along the water, and just before the river turns into Duskwood, TURN LEFT. Panthers are up there. Co-ords are 30 , 8
They are above the Ba'lal Ruins and To the east of the Ruins of Zul'Kunda!
If you go to 30,7 and go up the hill both the tigers and panthers can be found there. They respawn fairly fast too.

What are coordinates and how do i use them?
 you guys always are talking about it but i dont know how to use this...
replies: Coords are from a downloaded ui such as metamap or cosmos.  Just search for metamap or cosmos download it and follow the instructions.
